parameters.query:
SELECT
  id, name, description, price, category, stock, variants, image_url, tags
FROM products
WHERE
  business_id = '{{ $json.business_id }}'
  AND is_active = true
  AND (
    -- If the customer didn't ask for a specific product, just show them everything
    (LENGTH('{{ $json.entities?.product_category ?? "" }}') = 0 AND LENGTH('{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? "" }}') = 0)
    
    -- Otherwise, search by the category they asked for
    OR category ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.entities?.product_category ?? "" }}' || '%'
    
    -- Or search by the exact product name they asked for
    OR to_tsvector('english', name) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', '{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? "NO_MATCH" }}')
    OR name ILIKE '%' || '{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? "NO_MATCH" }}' || '%'
    OR '{{ $json.entities?.product_name ?? "NO_MATCH" }}' = ANY(tags)
  )
ORDER BY
  -- Show best sellers first when answering general questions
  CASE WHEN 'best seller' = ANY(tags) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
LIMIT 3;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversations (business_id, customer_number, direction, message_text)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Workflow Input').first().json.business_id }}', 
  '{{ $('Workflow Input').first().json.phoneNumber }}', 
  'outbound', 
  '{{ (typeof $('Format Agent Output').item.json.replyText === "string" ? $('Format Agent Output').item.json.replyText.replace(/'/g, "''") : JSON.stringify($('Format Agent Output').item.json.replyText).replace(/'/g, "''")) }}'
);


UPDATE customers 
SET active_flow = CASE 
    WHEN '{{ (typeof $('Format Agent Output').item.json.replyText === "string" ? $('Format Agent Output').item.json.replyText.replace(/'/g, "''") : JSON.stringify($('Format Agent Output').item.json.replyText).replace(/'/g, "''")) }}' ILIKE '%Name%' AND '{{ (typeof $('Format Agent Output').item.json.replyText === "string" ? $('Format Agent Output').item.json.replyText.replace(/'/g, "''") : JSON.stringify($('Format Agent Output').item.json.replyText).replace(/'/g, "''")) }}' ILIKE '%Address%' THEN 'checkout_flow'
    ELSE active_flow 
END
WHERE phone_number = '{{ $("Workflow Input").first().json.phoneNumber }}' 
AND business_id = '{{ $("Workflow Input").first().json.business_id }}';

messageValues.message:
==You are {{$json.business_name}}'s friendly WhatsApp sales assistant. Reply in the customer's language ({{$json.language}}).

Tone: warm, concise, like a helpful shop assistant. Use 1-2 emojis.

You are given:
- Customer intent: {{$json.intent}}
- Matched product(s): {{$json.products_json}}

Rules:
- Keep replies under 200 words.
- Always end with one clear next step.
- Never state a price not in the data.
- All prices in the data are base values (USD). You MUST convert them to LKR (multiply by 300) when quoting prices to the customer. Always format prices as 'LKR [amount]' (e.g., LKR 4500).
- If no matching product found, say so honestly.
- Do not include image URLs or links in your text. The system automatically attaches photos.
- If the customer is ready to buy or order, explicitly ask them for their: Name, Mobile Number, Delivery Address, and Preferred Payment Method (Cash on Delivery or Bank Transfer).
- CRITICAL: If the customer's message is just a simple acknowledgment (like 'ok', 'thanks') in response to an order being confirmed or placed, DO NOT ask them for delivery details again! Just respond with a friendly 'You're welcome! Let us know if you need anything else!'
